n41a97b6ac0c.s: Which of the following correctly describes DRDO?
o: Headquartered at Hyderabad; conducts agricultural research
Headquartered at Bengaluru; plans space missions
Headquartered at DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi; develops indigenous defence technology
Headquartered at Gandhinagar; regulates atomic energy
n41a97b6ac0c.x: DRDO is headquartered at DRDO Bhawan, New Delhi, and develops indigenous defence technology through its network of laboratories.

nindian-geography-22-37.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: National Institute of Abiotic Stress Management – Raipur
National Institute of Biotic Stress Management – Raipur
National Institute of Biotic Stress Management – Malegaon
National Institute of Abiotic Stress Management – Ranchi
nindian-geography-22-37.x: The National Institute of Biotic Stress Management is at Raipur; the National Institute of Abiotic Stress Management is at Malegaon near Baramati, Maharashtra.

nindian-geography-22-2.s: The National Atlas and Thematic Mapping Organisation (NATMO) is located at:
nindian-geography-22-2.x: NATMO is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, not Hyderabad (where NRSC is located).

nap-geography-18-2.s: Which of the following institutions in Andhra Pradesh is wrongly matched with its location?
nap-geography-18-2.x: NIOT (ocean technology) is at Thupilipallam, Nellore; the institute at Pedavegi, Eluru, is IIOPR for oil palm research.

n5eb8e007fbb.s: The National Academy of Sciences, India (NASI), regarded as India's oldest science academy, was founded in 1930 by:
n5eb8e007fbb.x: NASI was founded in 1930 by Meghnad Saha as the Uttar Pradesh Academy of Sciences and is regarded as the oldest science academy in India.

n451379fca63.s: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan (2015), which promotes inquiry-based learning of science and mathematics in schools, was launched by the:
o: Ministry of HRD (now Ministry of Education)
n451379fca63.x: Rashtriya Avishkar Abhiyan was launched in 2015 by the Ministry of HRD, now the Ministry of Education.

n2ebe4f57c33.s: Vigyan Prasar, set up in 1989 at New Delhi, is an autonomous organisation of the:
o: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research
n2ebe4f57c33.x: Vigyan Prasar is an autonomous organisation of the Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology.

n8c0cdff5e66.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: VAJRA – Overseas scientists, including NRIs and OCIs
PMRF – Women scientists returning after a career break
J.C. Bose Fellowship – Active senior scientists
n8c0cdff5e66.x: PMRF is for PhD scholars in IITs, IISc, IISERs and other top institutions and is administered by the Ministry of Education, not a career-break scheme.

n4a890dc6dc6.s: Which scheme, implemented with the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti, targets meritorious girl students of Classes 9 to 12?
n4a890dc6dc6.x: Vigyan Jyoti targets meritorious girl students in Classes 9 to 12 and is implemented with the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti.

nd608216048a.s: TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs), which supports ICT start-ups through incubators, is implemented by:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
nd608216048a.x: TIDE 2.0 is a MeitY programme launched in 2019 to support ICT and technology start-ups through incubators.

n94164ecbdfb.s: Which of the following pairs (PARAM system – host institute) is correctly matched?
n94164ecbdfb.x: PARAM Shivay is at IIT (BHU) Varanasi; PARAM Brahma is at IISER Pune, PARAM Pravega at IISc Bengaluru and PARAM Ganga at IIT Roorkee.

n258ed9af6db.s: Atal Tinkering Labs, which expose students to IoT, 3D printing and robotics, are set up for students of:
n258ed9af6db.x: ATLs are established in schools for students of grades 6–12.

ne6c118a21ab.s: In the National Supercomputing Mission, 'Rudra' refers to:
o: A server board on which the Rudra machines are built
A C-DAC high-performance computing chip programme
The interconnect used in all PARAM systems
ne6c118a21ab.x: The Rudra machines are built on the Rudra server; AUM is the separate C-DAC HPC chip programme.

n8c1462f1e2e.s: The National Quantum Mission, with an outlay of ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023–24 to 2030–31, is implemented by:
n8c1462f1e2e.x: The National Quantum Mission is under DST, with an outlay of ₹6,003.65 crore over eight years (2023–24 to 2030–31).

na777af50ea8.s: Classes of the MeitY's NIELIT Quantum and AI campus, Amaravati, are scheduled to begin in September 2026 at:
na777af50ea8.x: The NIELIT campus (Ministry of Electronics and IT) is to start classes from September 2026 at Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur.

nc0f65f62adf.s: Which was the first State in India to have a dedicated quantum computing policy?
nc0f65f62adf.x: Andhra Pradesh is the first State with a dedicated quantum computing policy and aims to make Amaravati Quantum Valley a top-five global quantum hub by 2030.

nbded0b158de.s: Meghnad Saha, regarded as the chief architect of river planning in India, prepared the original plan for the:
nbded0b158de.x: Meghnad Saha prepared the original plan for the Damodar Valley Project.

nd47b100ecff.s: Which group of scientists all worked at the Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science, Kolkata?
o: Homi Bhabha, Vikram Sarabhai, Satish Dhawan and C.V. Raman
Vikram Sarabhai, A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Raja Ramanna and S.N. Bose
J.C. Bose, Meghnad Saha, S.N. Bose and C.V. Raman
Srinivasa Ramanujan, Birbal Sahni, Homi Bhabha and Meghnad Saha
nd47b100ecff.x: J.C. Bose, Meghnad Saha, S.N. Bose and C.V. Raman all worked at IACS.

nphysics-9-2.s: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
o: Enrico Fermi moved from Italy to the USA.
Albert Einstein moved from Germany to Switzerland to the USA.
nphysics-9-2.x: Niels Bohr was Danish, working in Copenhagen, not German.

nbiology-13-3.s: The Jarvik-7 artificial heart was made by:
nbiology-13-3.x: Robert Jarvik made the Jarvik-7 artificial heart; Hans Berger developed the EEG.

n819a2b7e2bc.s: Which of the following pairs (scientist – area of work) is correctly matched?
n819a2b7e2bc.x: Birbal Sahni is associated with palaeobotany; Maheshwari with plant embryology, K.C. Mehta with cereal rusts and G.N. Ramachandran with protein structure.

nbiology-10-1.s: The Oparin–Haldane hypothesis deals with the:
o: Origin of life from simple chemicals
nbiology-10-1.x: Oparin and Haldane independently proposed that life arose from simple chemicals in a reducing early atmosphere; cell theory was given by Schleiden and Schwann.

nbiology-10-2.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: R.H. Whittaker – Chromosomal theory of inheritance
nbiology-10-2.x: Whittaker gave the five-kingdom classification; the chromosomal theory of inheritance is Sutton and Boveri's.

n89939a4fcd3.s: Venkatraman Ramakrishnan shared the 2009 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for studies of the:
o: Structure of the DNA double helix
Structure and function of the ribosome
n89939a4fcd3.x: Ramakrishnan shared the 2009 Chemistry Nobel for studies of the structure and function of the ribosome.

nphysics-9-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: James Chadwick – First Nobel Prize in Physics, 1901
Albert Einstein – Nobel Physics 1921, photoelectric effect
nphysics-9-4.x: Einstein won the 1921 Physics Nobel for the photoelectric effect; Röntgen won the first (1901), Planck in 1918 and Chadwick in 1935.

n2c0ad6614ed.s: Nobel laureate S. Chandrasekhar, who became a US citizen in 1953, was the nephew of:
n2c0ad6614ed.x: S. Chandrasekhar was C.V. Raman's nephew; he became a US citizen in 1953 and guided more than 50 PhD students.

n2f8046e1c42.s: Who became the first Asian to receive the Turing Award, in 1994?
n2f8046e1c42.x: Raj Reddy received the Turing Award in 1994 as its first Asian recipient.

n5e79e0fca1b.s: Which of the following is NOT a category of the Infosys Prize?
n5e79e0fca1b.x: The Infosys Prize covers engineering and computer science, humanities and social sciences, life sciences, mathematical sciences and physical sciences; military strategy is not a category.

n66b45fbde10.s: The fifth generation of computers is associated with:
o: Artificial intelligence, ULSI and parallel processing
n66b45fbde10.x: The fifth generation is associated with artificial intelligence, ultra-large-scale integration and parallel processing.

n8ed3bcaf128.s: The speed of a supercomputer is commonly expressed in:
n8ed3bcaf128.x: Supercomputers provide the highest processing power, and their speed is commonly expressed in FLOPS (floating-point operations per second).

n6f7bb61ddc2.s: The Android mobile operating system, associated with Google, is based on:
n6f7bb61ddc2.x: Android is Linux-based and associated with Google; iOS is Apple's, and BharOS was developed at IIT Madras.

ncaefd624676.s: A language translator that translates and runs a program line by line is called a/an:
ncaefd624676.x: An interpreter translates and executes line by line, while a compiler translates the whole program before execution.

ndb37ed12bf0.s: According to the ISC 2026 list, the world's fastest supercomputer is:
ndb37ed12bf0.x: China's LineShine topped the ISC 2026 supercomputer list, replacing the United States' El Capitan.

n2016445e002.s: A website opens for users of one ISP but not for users of another. This is consistent with:
o: Expiry of the website's domain name
ISP-level DNS poisoning, HTTP interception or SNI filtering
n2016445e002.x: ISPs may block sites through DNS poisoning, HTTP interception or SNI filtering, so access can differ between ISPs; the other causes would affect all users.

n103f0b0fb08.s: Chief Minister Naidu and Sunil Mittal discussed which of the following for Andhra Pradesh?
o: Coal mining, irrigation dams and inland waterways
Last-mile connectivity, data centres and an undersea cable landing station
Satellite launching and missile testing facilities
Steel plants, minor ports and airports
n103f0b0fb08.x: The discussion concerned last-mile connectivity, data centres and an undersea cable landing station for Andhra Pradesh.

na61001ef65c.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: IMAP – Deletes mail from the server after downloading it to one device
POP3 – Downloads mail to one device
na61001ef65c.x: IMAP keeps mail on the server and synchronises it across devices; it is POP3 that usually deletes mail from the server after download.

n8f8dafdefd9.s:
Assertion (A): HTTPS provides greater security for browser-server communication than HTTP.
Reason (R): HTTPS encrypts the traffic between the browser and the server through TLS.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8f8dafdefd9.x: Both are true, and TLS-based encryption directly explains why HTTPS is more secure than HTTP.

nbcece772e1f.s: Which of the following pairs (protocol element – meaning) is correctly matched?
o: Semantics – When and how fast to send data
nbcece772e1f.x: Syntax specifies the format of data, semantics the meaning of each field, and timing when and how fast data is sent.

n798dfedbe04.s: Since 2016, LinkedIn has been owned by:
n798dfedbe04.x: LinkedIn has been owned by Microsoft since 2016; Facebook belongs to Meta.

n304ac740148.s: Which of the following pairs (e-commerce model – transaction) is correctly matched?
o: B2C – Consumer sells to another consumer
C2C – Business sells to another business
D2C – Brand sells directly to the consumer without a middleman
B2B – Business sells to the consumer
n304ac740148.x: D2C is direct brand-to-consumer selling; B2B is business-to-business, B2C business-to-consumer and C2C consumer-to-consumer.

n3fcdf0b7587.s: Which e-mail field sends copies to several recipients without revealing their addresses to one another?
n3fcdf0b7587.x: BCC (blind carbon copy) hides the recipients' addresses from one another.

nb4b888d999f.s: Which was the first Indian news agency to offer syndicated video news?
nb4b888d999f.x: ANI, established in 1971, was the first Indian news agency to offer syndicated video news.

n5cfa34a44a5.s: A system in which computing is tightly integrated with physical processes, a core element of Industry 4.0, is called a:
n5cfa34a44a5.x: A cyber-physical system integrates computing closely with physical processes and is central to Industry 4.0 and NM-ICPS.

nd0d18668c14.s: Which of the following pairs (processor – developer) is correctly matched?
nd0d18668c14.x: AJIT was developed by IIT Bombay; DHRUV64 by C-DAC, SHAKTI by IIT Madras and Vikram 3201 by ISRO's Semi-Conductor Laboratory, Chandigarh.

n23979e538d8.s: SAMARTH Udyog Bharat 4.0, which spreads Industry 4.0 through demonstration centres, is an initiative of the:
n23979e538d8.x: SAMARTH (Smart Advanced Manufacturing and Rapid Transformation Hub) Udyog Bharat 4.0 is a Ministry of Heavy Industries initiative.

n5a001d0d364.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: SAHI – Strategy for AI in Healthcare
n5a001d0d364.x: MedTech Mitra is associated with ICMR-CDSCO, not MeitY and Google.

n53c14f34ede.s: India became a founding member of the Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI) in:
n53c14f34ede.x: India joined GPAI as a founding member on 15 June 2020.

n552d67b574b.s: Which of the following pairs (AI summit – host city) is correctly matched?
n552d67b574b.x: The AI Action Summit 2025 was held in Paris; REAIM 2023 was at The Hague and the AI Seoul Summit 2024 in Seoul.

n1b9703147cc.s:
Assertion (A): MATH is an AI/ML hub set up by DST and the Telangana government with T-Hub.
Reason (R): The stated aim of MATH is modernising higher education.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1b9703147cc.x: MATH is indeed an AI/ML hub of DST and the Telangana government with T-Hub, but modernising higher education is not its stated aim (APPSC 2023 key).

nc73512e04ff.s: Which of the following pairs (cloud service model – what the user receives) is correctly matched?
o: SaaS – Platform to build and run applications
PaaS – Ready software over the web
nc73512e04ff.x: IaaS provides infrastructure such as servers, storage and networks; PaaS provides a development platform and SaaS ready software over the web.

n0bd8e045de0.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Stablecoins are pegged to fiat currencies, commodities or crypto-assets.
2. Tokenisation means mining new coins to validate transactions.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n0bd8e045de0.x: Statement 1 is correct. Tokenisation converts ownership rights in an asset into a blockchain token; mining is what validates transactions.

nc3a7064a9b4.s: EDGE, a faster GSM data technology, is generally classified as:
nc3a7064a9b4.x: GPRS is associated with 2.5G and EDGE with 2.75G, both intermediate GSM data developments.

nb91dd2cb62f.s: Starlink, which operates more than 8,000 LEO satellites, obtained its GMPCS licence in India in:
nb91dd2cb62f.x: Starlink received its GMPCS licence in India in 2025; Eutelsat OneWeb had earlier received a letter of intent.

nphysics-17-35.s: Which of the following pairs (radiation – use) is correctly matched?
o: Visible light – Radio-frequency pulses in MRI
Infrared radiation – Remote controls and short-range data communication
nphysics-17-35.x: Infrared runs remote controls and short-range data links; MRI uses radio-frequency pulses and Li-Fi uses visible light.

n63b9970383a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Edge computing processes data near its source, reducing latency and bandwidth use.
2. Fog computing sits between edge computing and the cloud.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n63b9970383a.x: Edge computing processes data near the source with lower latency and bandwidth use, and fog computing sits between the edge and the cloud.

nc3cb51a81a6.s: 5G can provide latency as low as about:
nc3cb51a81a6.x: 5G can offer latency as low as 1 millisecond, along with massive device connectivity and high reliability.

n85ae9ce1d79.s: Which of the following pairs (Digital India pillar – pillar number) is correctly matched?
n85ae9ce1d79.x: Broadband Highways, Universal Access to Mobile/Phones, Public Internet Access Programme and Information for All are pillars 1, 2, 3 and 6 respectively.

n47e5da1d910.s: PMGDISHA, the rural digital literacy scheme launched in 2017, aims to cover:
n47e5da1d910.x: PMGDISHA is a rural digital literacy scheme that aims to cover one person per household.

nba2519e739e.s: The 'One Class, One TV Channel' approach through DTH, radio and podcasts is a feature of:
nba2519e739e.x: PM eVIDYA uses One Class, One TV Channel through DTH, radio and podcasts and integrates DIKSHA and SWAYAM.

n74f24c662f1.s: Under Semicon 2.0, which of the following pairs (pillar – maximum support) is correctly matched?
o: Compound and display fabs – 40% capital subsidy
n74f24c662f1.x: CMOS silicon fabs get up to 40% capital subsidy; compound/display fabs and advanced packaging 35%, and R&D up to 75% of project cost.

nda24a2051ea.s: NIELIT, which provides IT and electronics training, is a deemed-to-be University under the:
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
nda24a2051ea.x: NIELIT is a deemed-to-be University under MeitY, associated with IT and electronics training.
